# PpdsConnectionStringBuilder

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Provider.PpdsConnectionStringBuilder`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Builds and parses connection strings for the PPDS ADO.NET provider. Format: Url=https://org.crm.dynamics.com;AuthType=OAuth;ClientId=...;ClientSecret=...;TenantId=...
